variable.description: (Required) The UUID of your control plane. This variable is available in the Konnect manager.

request.description: Retrieve a pinned dataplane client certificate associated to this control plane. A pinned dataplane certificate allows dataplanes configured with the certificate and corresponding private key to establish connection with this control plane.
